items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: Cliff Richter played viola in the symphony and I was playing bass, of course.

ctx.x: What about Xavier University? What is that?

Oh, uh, yes, Xavier University. Well, I tell you. Uh... Oh, just about the last year before I left New Orleans, Cliff Richter played viola in the symphony and I was playing bass, of course. And, uh, Cliff was teaching at Xavier and he was a very ardent lover of Bach and chamber music and so on and so forth. And through his efforts, he finally taught a mother, what's her name there, who was in charge of the school, to put on some chamber music, Xavier. And he would guarantee that there, you know, there would be a…

who plays classical music, dreams of the time when you can play a little chamber music, because actually you're playing one part and you're playing it all along and you're the only guy doing it, and boy, it's just a real kick to hear yourself playing a certain line. Well anyway, these concerts were very, very successful. In fact, so successful that Alexander Hillsburg attended them, at least one of them, you know, and that was quite a thing to drag him out of there. He usually doesn't go and listens to very many…
